data.Description: Geomodelling namespace for Drogon - bridges collaboration (SoE) with trusted data (SoR).

LifecycleEvents.Name: Project created
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Post-DG1 approval. Collaboration namespace established for DG2 geomodelling.

LifecycleEvents.Name: FMU volumes ingested
LifecycleEvents.Remark: REV raw + statistics (3 realisations, 7 segments) added to trusted collection. Source: fmu-ensemble-framework run #47.

LifecycleEvents.Name: GeoLabelSet published
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Headline volumes per segment promoted to GeoLabelSet. P50 STOIIP = 312 MSm³.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Porosity risk escalated
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Floodplain facies porosity revised downward (0.18→0.14) after core data review. Risk severity: Medium→High. Affected segments: CentralFlanks, SouthWing.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Volumes re-estimated post porosity revision
LifecycleEvents.Remark: P50 STOIIP revised 312→287 MSm³ (-8%). CentralFlanks and SouthWing most affected. New FMU run #52 with updated porosity model.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Production forecast added
LifecycleEvents.Remark: 20-year production profile (OPM Flow). 7 producers, 3 injectors, WAG from year 5.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Reduced-scope alternative registered
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Alternative B: 2-segment development (CentralHorst + CentralSouth only). Lower CAPEX, faster payback, leaves 40% upside for later phases.

LifecycleEvents.Name: Fault compartment risk reduced
LifecycleEvents.Remark: 4D seismic reprocessing confirms pressure communication across NE fault. Severity: High→Low.

LifecycleEvents.Name: DG2 evidence package frozen
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Evidence collection locked for DG2 gate review. 99 artifacts in package. Gate meeting scheduled 2026-05-15.

LifecycleEvents.Name: DG2 approved — proceed to FEED
LifecycleEvents.Remark: Full 7-segment development approved. Condition: acquire additional core in CentralFlanks before DG3. NPV(10%) = 2.1 BUSD.
